scheduled_maintenances.name: TLS certificate lifecycle change and certificate pinning guidance

incident_updates.body:
Who is affected: Customers whose systems perform certificate pinning for our TLS certificates.
Products affected: All services and APIs secured with our TLS certificates.

Changes:

- Certificate lifecycle update: Due to upcoming industry-wide changes in certificate validation and lifecycle management, the validity period of TLS certificates will be significantly reduced. In the near future, TLS certificates will have a maximum validity of 47 days, requiring significantly more frequent renewal and rotation.
- Certificate pinning considerations: As a result of the shortened certificate lifecycle, implementations that rely on pinning to a specific leaf certificate will no longer be sustainable. Systems that continue to pin to a specific certificate may experience connectivity disruptions whenever certificates are renewed as part of the automated rotation process.
- Alignment with recommended practices: We recommend avoiding certificate pinning for our TLS certificates. More details can be found on the following link: https://developer.telesign.com/enterprise/docs/authentication#tls-and-certificates. Instead, integrations should rely on standard TLS validation mechanisms using trusted Certificate Authorities. This approach ensures compatibility with automated certificate rotation and aligns with industry best practices.
- Automated certificate rotation: Our platform will continue to manage certificate issuance, renewal, and rotation automatically as part of the updated lifecycle model.

How this may affect you:

- Customers using certificate pinning: If your systems currently perform certificate pinning for our TLS certificates, you should review and update your implementation to remove pinning to specific certificates. Failure to do so may result in service connectivity issues once certificates are rotated under the new lifecycle model.
- Customers using standard TLS validation: No action is required if your systems rely on standard TLS trust validation through trusted Certificate Authorities.

Additional information:

- We strongly recommend reviewing your integrations and aligning them with the guidance provided in our developer documentation using https://developer.telesign.com/enterprise/docs/authentication#tls-and-certificates to ensure uninterrupted service operation under the updated certificate lifecycle.
- If you have any questions or require assistance, please reach out to your dedicated Customer Success Manager or contact Customer Support.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Regulatory Update: 📢 Important Update: Austria Sender ID Registration Requirement

incident_updates.body: We will be undergoing scheduled maintenance during this time.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

The Austrian regulatory authority (RTR) has introduced mandatory Sender ID registration in Austria. Starting 1 October, only registered Sender IDs will be accepted for message delivery.


Registration Details

Registration portal opened: 1 July
Updated submission deadline: 11 September
Activation time: Approximately 14 days after submission
Registration fee: Currently no fees apply


Required Information
Please provide the following information for each Sender ID registration:

Sender ID name
Company legal name
Company URL
Justification/proof of the connection between the company name and the Sender ID
Company address: City, Street, Postal Code, Country
Company contact email
Purpose of the SMS (e.g., OTP, 2FA, promotional offers, notifications)
Sample message
Letter of Authorization (LOA)
For reseller customers, we will accept the full chain of authorization:
From the end client to the reseller partner, and
From the reseller partner to Telesign.

Additional Information

From 1 October, messages sent with registered Sender IDs will be delivered successfully.
Unregistered Sender IDs will be blocked.
If a registered Sender ID is used by someone other than its registered owner, it will be replaced with "Unbekannt" (Unknown).

Generic Sender IDs are not permitted.
Sender IDs are case-sensitive.
German special characters (ä, ö, ü, ß) are not allowed.
Sender IDs may contain letters, numbers, spaces, and special characters, but cannot consist solely of numbers or begin or end with a space.

Under § 5b(1) of the Austrian Kommunikationsparameter-, Entgelt- und Mehrwertdiensteverordnung 2009 (KEM-V 2009), RTR is required to maintain a public register containing certain Sender ID registration details, including the holder's company name, address, email address and Sender ID. While the publication of this information is therefore part of the regulatory requirements, as a practical measure, we would recommend using a generic corporate email address, preferably one that is already publicly available, rather than an individual employee's email address.


✅ Action Required
Please submit all required information and the Letter of Authorization (LOA) no later than 11 September to allow sufficient time for registration and ensure continued message delivery after 1 October.

This is the latest information currently available. We will share any additional updates as soon as they become available.

Thank you for your attention to this important regulatory update.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Regulatory Update 📢 Australia and ACMA's SMS Sender ID Register - Jun 2026

incident_updates.body:
Summary
Following up on our earlier update (https://status.telesign.com/incidents/hg1jmtfjdfj1), Telesign can now fully support all registration scenarios listed below, with an alternative verification option available for direct brand owners with ABN (Australia Business Number). The required documents in Registration Pre-steps remain the same. Additionally, 2-way DLC solution remains available, with no setup fee and only a monthly fee of US$2.50 per DLC. Expected registration timeline is around 1-2 weeks.

Registration Pre-steps
To register an alphanumeric Sender ID for Australia, please complete the following forms:
● Registration Form: 
https://telesign.sharepoint.com/:x:/g/Sales/IQB1BQgIwBHiSZ_zS9q5Pa32AZ_8Ka-oVHBSv7-DEgL60dY?e=CVCFHx  (Expired 7.16.2026)

Registration Process:
♦ Direct Brand Ownership
>Scenario A
(1) Direct Brand Owner with ABN (Recommended Option): You will be able to register alphanumeric Sender IDs with standard business verification steps. ACMA will manage and trigger the business verification via the email sender "Australian Communications and Media Authority <no-reply@digital.acma.gov.au>".
(2) Direct Brand Owner with ABN : There is also an alternative verification pathway with extra charges, via Certified Telcos, where there is no direct ACMA involvement and no direct verification action is required from brand owner.
 
>Scenario B
Direct Brand Owner without ABN (international / business identification number that is not from Australia): Registrations require enhanced third-party verification, handled via certified participation pathways. The recommendation is for the authorized business POC to be visibly connected to the company and/or be on official documents to streamline the verification checks.

♦ Non-Direct Brand Ownership
>Scenario C
• Non-Direct traffic from Brand Owner with and without ABN: Registration of alphanumeric Sender IDs for Australia is now available and requires the files found under Registration Pre-steps .
• If the represented brand has an ABN, the brand-owner is required to pursue verification directly via ACMA (similar to Scenario A-1), or through the alternative verification pathway (similar to Scenario A-2).
• If the represented brand does not have an ABN, registrations require enhanced third-party verification, handled through certified participation pathways (Similar to Scenario B)

Note: For all registration scenarios, applicable fees may apply.

Please also refer to Telesign’s full guidance for scenario-based registration requirements (https://support.telesign.com/s/article/australia---messaging-regulations). For any questions or assistance, contact your Customer Success Manager or reach out to enablement@telesign.com.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Regulatory Update: 📢 Important Update: UAE Sender ID Verification Requirement

incident_updates.body: Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

To comply with a new operator-driven compliance requirement in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), all customers using international alphanumeric Sender IDs for SMS traffic to the UAE must complete a mandatory Sender ID verification process.

The requirement has been introduced by the UAE operators and applies to previously registered Sender IDs. Failure to complete the verification process may result in the suspension of affected Sender IDs, which could impact SMS delivery to the UAE.

At this time, no widespread blocking has been observed. However, enforcement may begin with limited notice.

Required Documents:

- Certificate of Incorporation, Articles of Association, or equivalent documentation demonstrating that the entity is headquartered outside the UAE (UAE-issued documents alone are not sufficient).

- Government-issued photo ID of the owner or authorized representative.

- Letter of Authorization (LOA) on the company's letterhead authorizing Telesign to verify and manage the Sender ID on the customer's behalf.

- A Letter of Authorization on the brand's letterhead confirming the authorized signatory

- A chain Letter of Authorization for non-direct clients


Required Details:

- Legal entity name and registration number.

- Company website.

- Location of the company's global headquarters (ultimate parent company or highest-level corporate office), together with supporting evidence (e.g., official company documents, corporate publications, or website information).
Please note that companies with global headquarters in the UAE are not eligible for this service.

- Business contact details, including the email address of the authorized representative (personal email addresses such as Gmail, Yahoo, or Hotmail are not accepted).

✅ Action Required
If you receive a request from Telesign regarding your UAE Sender ID(s), please submit all required documentation and information as soon as possible to avoid potential service disruptions. Sender IDs that are not successfully verified may be suspended by the UAE operators, resulting in SMS delivery issues.
Our teams are actively working with our connectivity partners and the operators to clarify the implementation timeline and minimize customer impact. We will continue to provide updates as additional information becomes available.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this important compliance requirement.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Regulatory Update: 📢 Important Update: Spain Sender ID Registration Requirement

incident_updates.body: Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

The Directorate of Telecommunications and Audiovisual of the National Markets and Competition Commission (CNMC) of Spain has introduced a mandatory Sender ID Registry (Registro de Alias) under Order TDF/149/2025.

This regulation applies to all companies, both Spanish and international, that use alphanumeric Sender IDs to send SMS or RCS messages to Spanish mobile numbers. Beginning September 15, 2026, Spanish mobile operators will be legally required to block any SMS, MMS, or RCS message sent using an alphanumeric Sender ID that is not registered in the CNMC Sender ID Registry. Any traffic sent using an unregistered Sender ID after this date will not be delivered. Numeric Sender IDs are not affected by this requirement.

Registration with the CNMC is free of charge. Organizations that have access to a Spanish digital certificate can register their Sender IDs directly through the CNMC Sender ID Registry Portal. Organizations without a Spanish digital certificate can authorize Telesign Corporation to complete the registration on their behalf by providing a signed Letter of Authorization (LOA) together with the required registration information.

Reseller customers should be aware that each Sender ID must be registered by its respective owner, and Telesign can only submit registrations for organizations that have provided a Letter of Authorization directly to Telesign. A chain of Letters of Authorization is not permitted under the CNMC registration process.


✅ Action Required

If you use alphanumeric Sender IDs to send SMS or RCS traffic to Spanish mobile numbers, please ensure that your Sender IDs are registered with the CNMC before September 15, 2026. We encourage you to begin the registration process as soon as possible to allow sufficient time for completion before the enforcement date and to avoid potential service disruptions.

Please also refer to Telesign's full guidance for scenario-based registration requirements, including detailed registration instructions, required documentation, Letter of Authorization (LOA) templates, and reseller-specific guidance: https://support.telesign.com/s/article/spain---messaging-regulations. 


For any questions or assistance, please contact your Customer Success Manager or reach out to enablement@telesign.com.


Thank you for your prompt attention to this important regulatory requirement.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Regulatory Update:📢Important Announcement: Brazil regulatory change affecting betting customers

incident_updates.body: Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.
We will be undergoing scheduled maintenance during this time.

We want to make you aware of a significant regulatory change that may affect clients sending online betting or gambling-related messaging traffic to Brazil.

On September 25, 2026, the Brazilian government issued a provisional measure prohibiting the operation, offering, intermediation, promotion, and advertising of online betting platforms in Brazil. The measure took immediate effect and establishes a transition period through October 5, 2026, with affected betting websites and applications expected to be taken offline beginning October 6, 2026. The provisional measure remains subject to review and approval by the Brazilian Congress.

To support compliance with the new requirements, Telesign is reviewing its controls for messaging traffic delivered to Brazil. This may include enhanced monitoring or filtering of SMS content associated with online betting and gambling, including promotional messages, sender information, URLs, domains, and other relevant traffic indicators. The internal review was initiated in response to the announced implementation timeline.


Required client action

Clients sending messaging traffic to Brazil should:

Review your SMS use cases, message templates, sender information, URLs, and associated campaigns for any connection to online betting or gambling.
Discontinue traffic that may be prohibited under the new measure within the applicable regulatory timeline.
Avoid submitting new betting or gambling-related promotional traffic for delivery to Brazil.
Consult qualified legal or regulatory counsel to determine how the measure applies to their specific services and activities.
 
Messages identified as potentially inconsistent with applicable requirements or Telesign policies may be blocked or otherwise restricted. Because the situation continues to develop, additional controls or guidance may be introduced as further information becomes available.

We understand that this change may require immediate operational adjustments. We recognize that the regulatory environment is developing quickly and that clients may require support assessing the operational impact. Your Telesign account team is available to discuss and help identify potentially affected traffic. This communication is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. Clients remain responsible for ensuring that their traffic and services comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and industry requirements.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Regulatory Update: 📢 Announcement: Uzbekistan - Compulsory Registration of All Alphanumeric Sender IDs and Whitelisting of All SMS contents on Uzbekistan Ucell Network

incident_updates.body:
Starting from 30th October 2026, all SMS messages on Ucell network must come from a registered sender ID. Generic sender IDs are not allowed for usage and registration. The sender ID and message content must exactly correspond to the information submitted for registration. Any manipulation or modification of the registered message content may not simply result in message failure, but the associated sender ID may be blocked and removed from registration. 

For each sender ID and message registering, please provide the following information:

1. Desired Sender ID
2. Company details (full name, website, country of HQ)
3. Message type (OTP/ARN/MKT)
4. Message format and length of the OTP code (eg. 4/6/8 digits, etc). If your messages involve multiple variables, please define them clearly.

To ensure uninterrupted delivery of SMS traffic, please submit your SID and message contents before end of October. 

For new sender IDs registrations, approval may take up to 3–4 weeks. There are no fees associated with this process. Please note that purely numeric codes are not permitted for use in Uzbekistan.

If you have any questions or require assistance, please contact our Support team or your Customer Success Manager.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Upcoming Mandatory Template Requirement — Effective July 15th, 2026

incident_updates.body: Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

This is an important compliance update that requires your attention. 
 
Starting July 15th, 2026, all OTP and Transactional messages sent via the Viber channel must be sent exclusively through Message Templates that are registered and approved by Viber. This is in line with Rakuten Viber's platform-wide initiative to standardize critical business communications. For more information, you can find Rakuten Viber's blog post here. 

 
What are Message Templates? 
 
Message Templates are pre-approved, structured message formats that allow businesses to communicate consistently with their users while maintaining the flexibility of dynamic variables. They are reviewed and approved by the Rakuten Viber team to ensure compliance with Viber's messaging guidelines. 
 
Why this matters: Transactional messages represent some of the most critical touchpoints between your brand and your customers — such as order confirmations, OTPs, and account alerts. Templates ensure these messages are instantly recognizable, easy to act upon, and trusted by recipients. 
 
Important notes: 
 
 

Any Transactional message sent outside of an approved template will be charged at the Promotional rate 

You will be able to send OTP messages using the below preapproved template:   otp_verify    

Any message content outside the above template content - will go through to Viber and will be charged as Promotional 

New Template Creation and Registration API and Changes to Send message will be shared by August 15th - to register templates via API and start consumption 

For registering new templates until the API method is available, please reach out to your dedicated business Partner or Telesign Support team 

 

 

We understand that changes of this nature require time and preparation, and our team is committed to supporting you through this transition. If you have any questions or require assistance, please do not hesitate to contact your Telesign Business Manager or reach out to our Support team. 

 

Thank you for your continued partnership.
